## Change / Cambio

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if any.

## Validation / Validación

Explain what was tested and any remaining limitations.

- [ ] Scope is focused; no unrelated changes.
- [ ] JVM tests, lint and Debug pass; relevant instrumented tests run.
- [ ] ES/EN, Light/Dark and portrait/landscape checked when UI changes.
- [ ] Privacy reviewed if data, permissions or dependencies change.
- [ ] No secrets, signing material, personal data, local configuration or installable binaries.
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed.
